## Wave 9 Summary

This is the session-x **closeout**: after W1–W8 each reconcile + UPDATE one phononic document to the current (S93-era) aggregate state, Wave 9 verifies that the eight UPDATED documents are **mutually consistent + collectively comprehensive** — they agree on the shared constants they each cite, carry the same substrate-IS framing invariants, and (the coverage axis) collectively cover every major S93-era development that touches multiple documents — and that those values agree with the non-superseded `canonical_constants.py` / `mcp__knowledge__get_constant` canonical. Per `session-x-context.md §3` and the partition manifest: **W9 is a VERIFICATION SWEEP, not a progressive derivation.** It does NOT re-run any wave's aggregate-sourcing discipline; it does NOT change W1–W8's verdicts or re-mine the knowledge base to re-derive constants. It only checks post-update mutual consistency (a row-by-row agreement test) + cross-document coverage (a development-presence test) across the eight documents and confirms each agrees with the canonical reference. W9 reads the W1–W8 outputs; it never writes to any of the eight documents.

Two gates, tightly coupled:
- **`WX-W9-1 SHARED-CONSTANT-MATRIX`** — build an agreement matrix: rows = constants appearing in ≥2 of the 8 documents; columns = the 8 documents + a `canonical_constants.py`/`get_constant` reference column; cells = the value each updated doc carries. PASS = every shared constant agrees across all docs that cite it AND matches the non-superseded canonical (to presentation precision); **disambiguated quantities are listed as DISTINCT rows, not forced to agree**; FAIL = any residual cross-document disagreement on the SAME quantity; INFO = a disagreement that is a legitimate distinct-quantity split needing a one-line annotation.
- **`WX-W9-2 COVERAGE-CONSISTENCY`** — build a coverage+framing matrix: rows = the 8 documents; columns = the four framing invariants (IS-not-IN direction; fold-is-first-order-transit-not-singularity; the canonical `tau` story; substrate-derives-LCDM-not-container) PLUS a **cross-document coverage axis** — a set of major S93-era developments pertinent to MULTIPLE documents (DILUTION-CC; the §VII cross-pillar bridge program; spectral-dimension `d_s` flow vs CDT; the two-scale `α_s`) that must NOT be integrated into one document while missed by another that owns an overlapping domain. PASS = all 8 docs framing-compliant on all four invariants AND no cross-document coverage gap (every multi-doc development is either present in, or consistently scoped-out by cross-reference from, each document whose domain it touches). This is the COVERAGE-CONSISTENCY gate the W2/W6/W7/W8 plan footers hand off to (each wave's scoped-out gap rows + multi-doc developments land here for the cross-document coverage sweep).

The carry-forward source is the session-x aggregate-review directive: the cross-document closeout IS the W9 "item." These are AUDIT-trigger consistency gates, not numerical-threshold compute gates; the analytical work is the matrix construction + per-cell adjudication by `gen-physicist`, formalized at close by a small dual-SHA closure script so the v3 ladder and `_yaml_gate_validator.py` stay intact for prose gates.

**Default classification: GEOMETRIC** (the shared constants are substrate-geometry / spectral-moment quantities — `tau_fold`, `c_Gold`, `c_fabric`, `N_cells`, `M_KK`, `Delta_BCS` — and the framing invariants are the spectral-triple-IS direction; the matrix is a cross-document structural consistency check on the fabric's own quantities, not a particle-content or pure-phonon-excitation computation). Cosmology/observation constants that appear in the matrix (`CC_OOM`, `n_s`, `w0_FW`, e-fold counts) are PHONONIC-substrate observables; the framing-compliance gate's IS-not-IN axis is the substrate-direction check per `phononic-framing.md`.

**Breadth-owner discipline (gen-physicist)**: W9 classifies each cross-document disagreement within the framework first — a disagreement is either (i) the SAME quantity rendered inconsistently (FAIL), (ii) a presentation-precision rounding of one quantity (PASS-with-note), or (iii) a structurally-DISTINCT quantity that shares a label/neighborhood and must NOT be forced to agree (INFO distinct-row). The cautionary case from context §2 — the `tau` quartet (`tau_0~0.15` stabilization attempt, `tau=0.2015` earlier fold estimate, `tau_fold=0.190` canonical transit fold, `tau~0.22` Penrose "physical universe" epoch) — is the canonical (iii): W9 lists these as DISTINCT rows and verifies no document collapses them, exactly as the W1/W5/W6 UPDATE gates were instructed to disambiguate (not overwrite) them. W9 does not re-adjudicate the disambiguation; it verifies the eight documents render it consistently. The same breadth-owner discipline applies to the WX-W9-2 coverage axis: a development PRESENT in one document and ABSENT from another is classified as (i) a genuine cross-document coverage gap (the absent document owns an overlapping domain and should carry the development OR an explicit cross-reference to the owning document — FAIL/INFO per severity), or (ii) a correctly-scoped non-overlap (the development belongs to exactly one document's domain and the others legitimately do not cover it — COVERED-at-document-set-level, no gap). The coverage check is a cross-document COMPLETENESS test, the dual of the SHARED-CONSTANT-MATRIX's cross-document CONSISTENCY test; together they certify the eight documents are mutually consistent AND collectively comprehensive.

W9 consumes the eight UPDATED documents; each document's UPDATE gate `WX-W{i}-2` MUST have landed (verdict present in `computations/session-x/sx_gate_verdicts.txt`, document edits applied) before W9 executes at `/rclab-coordinate` time. **Honest closure on unmet prerequisites** (per `.claude/rules/mechanical-closure-discipline.md` §"When mechanical closure IS acceptable"): if at W9 dispatch ANY `WX-W{i}-2` UPDATE has verdict ≠ landed-PASS (missing line, FAIL, or document not edited), the W9 gate that consumes it honestly closes with `value='PRE-REG-INC_blocked_by_WX-W{i}-2_<status>'` — never PASS, never convention-shopped. The closure script writes the FAIL/PRE-REG-INC verdict line AND updates the WP §W9 section's `**Status**`/`**Verdict**` blocks in the same run (item 5 of the discipline; no task-complete-lie). The blocking prereq is named in the verdict `value=` string so a future audit (`_mechanical_closure_audit.py`) can grep the named upstream gate in the same verdict file. Per the partition manifest, W9 is **droppable at the Phase-3b checkpoint** without affecting W1–W8 — so a W9 PRE-REG-INC does NOT invalidate the standalone updated documents; it only defers the cross-document agreement certificate.

This dependency is asymmetric and one-directional: **W1–W8 verdicts → W9 reads.** W9 has no write-back to any of the eight documents (it is a verification sweep). A document the executor finds inconsistent at W9 is recorded in the matrix as a residual cross-document disagreement; the remediation (re-running the relevant `WX-W{i}-2` after correction) is a W{i}-side action, surfaced by W9, not performed by W9.

method:

    Cross-document consistency SWEEP (NOT a progressive derivation; context §3). For each shared
    constant (rows = constants appearing in >=2 of the 8 updated docs), the executor builds an
    agreement matrix: columns = the 8 documents + a canonical reference column sourced from
    get_constant / canonical_constants.py. Each cell = the value the corresponding updated document
    carries for that constant (extracted from the post-WX-W{i}-2 document text), or "-" if the doc
    does not cite it. The executor adjudicates each row into one of three classes:
      (PASS-row)  every citing doc agrees with every other AND with the canonical to presentation

      (INFO-row)  the disagreement is a legitimate DISTINCT-quantity split (e.g. tau_fold=0.190 vs
                  the Penrose-epoch tau~0.22) — listed as separate rows, each agreeing internally,
                  with a one-line annotation naming WHY they are distinct (scale, channel, epoch,

      (FAIL-row)  a residual SAME-quantity cross-document disagreement beyond presentation precision
                  (one doc still carries a stale value the other docs / canonical do not).
    The closure script loads the 8 documents (each SHA-pinned at dispatch = the post-update state),
    the canonical_constants snapshot, and the agent-authored matrix (markdown table in the WP),

# (7) substitution_chain — required: the ratio claim in the shared set
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    The shared set contains a directional/ratio claim that MUST be carried as an explicit chain
    (per math-scripts.md §"Double-Check Logic Before Compute"): the 229.5 sound-speed ratio. The
    chain proves that the "229x" / "229.5" / "229.48" / "229.4794" renderings across W1/W2/W3/W5/W8
    are the SAME quantity at different presentation precision (so the row is AGREE-class, not a
    cross-document disagreement). This is the highest-leverage agreement row (it appears in 5 of 8
    documents and feeds the CMB feature l ~ pi x 229.5 ~ 721).

    Claim: "the c_fabric/c_Gold sound-speed hierarchy is ONE quantity ~ 229.5, consistently rendered
            across the five documents that cite it (the renderings 229x, 229.5, 229.48, 229.4794
            agree to presentation precision)."

    Substitution chain:
      Step 1: c_fabric = 209.97368021  [canonical_constants.py / get_constant("c_fabric"); the value
              every document's hierarchy is built on]
      Step 2: c_Gold   = 0.915         [canonical_constants.py / get_constant("c_Gold")]
      Step 3: ratio = c_fabric / c_Gold                                  [definition of the hierarchy]
      Step 4: Substitute and simplify (Sage-exact, QQ-coerced to avoid float drift near the rounding
              boundary):
                ratio = 209.97368021 / 0.915
                      = 20997368021 / 91500000          [Sage QQ exact rational]
                      = 229.479431923...                [Sage .n(digits=12)]
      Step 5: round(229.479431923, 1) = 229.5 ; round(229.479431923, 2) = 229.48 ; the integer-
              magnitude "229x" rendering = floor-to-leading-digits of the same value.
      Direction: all four doc renderings (229x, 229.5, 229.48, 229.4794) are the SAME exact ratio
              229.479431923 at successively coarser presentation precision; |any pair difference| is
              a rounding artifact << 1e-3 relative -> the row is AGREE-class.
      Conclusion: the 229.5 hierarchy row PASSES the agreement test iff every citing document's
              rendering rounds to 229.48 (2 dp); a document carrying a value that does NOT round to
              229.48 (i.e. a stale or re-derived ratio) would make this a DISAGREE-row. Sage-exact
              cross-check is MANDATORY here per math-scripts.md §"Mnemonic-vs-exact ratio discipline"
              (the float 229.5 is a mnemonic; the exact rational 20997368021/91500000 is canonical).

    Secondary documented chain (the acoustic e-fold DISTINCT-SPLIT, row D2 — documents WHY 2.92 and
    2.72 are NOT the same quantity, so they are separate rows, not a disagreement):

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  The disagreement set is EMPTY: every shared constant that appears in >=2 of the 8 updated documents
  agrees across all citing documents AND matches the non-superseded canonical to presentation precision
  (and exactly for integer constants), and every legitimate distinct-quantity split (tau quartet,
  e-fold channels, n_s pair, sin^2(theta_W) pair, Mach pair, BCS-gap-vs-GL-amplitude) is rendered as a
  separate, internally-consistent row correctly NOT forced to agree. This certifies that the eight
  W1-W8 UPDATE gates produced a mutually-consistent, canonical-agreeing constant surface across the
  whole phononic document family. PASS does NOT re-derive any constant; it asserts the post-update
  cross-document agreement.
FAIL_meaning: >
  At least one residual SAME-quantity cross-document disagreement survives (one document still carries
  a value the other citing documents / canonical do not, beyond presentation precision) OR a distinct
  quantity was collapsed (e.g. a document renders a bare 0.2015 / 0.22 as "the fold" instead of the
  canonical 0.190, conflating the tau quartet). The named disagreeing document + constant is the
  blocker; remediation is a W{i}-side re-run of the relevant WX-W{i}-2 after correction (surfaced by
  W9, not performed by W9). The constant's row is excluded from the certified agreement set until the
  W{i} gap is closed.
INFO_meaning: >
  Every shared constant agrees on its SAME-quantity rows, but >=1 row is a legitimate DISTINCT-quantity
  split that needs a one-line annotation to document WHY the values differ (different scale / channel /
  epoch / lab-vs-substrate) — e.g. the tau quartet rendered as four distinct epochs, or the
  Planck-vs-framework n_s pair, or the substrate-vs-MS-bar sin^2(theta_W) pair. INFO records the
  distinct-split annotations (the rows are correct AS distinct rows; they are not contradictions). An
  INFO gate is a clean closeout with documented distinct-quantity structure, not an unresolved defect.

# ---- Effort + framing ----
effort:

    - "computations/session-x/sx_w9_shared_constant_matrix.npz"      # optional

  estimated_time: "0.5 wave-equivalents (extracting each shared constant from each of the 8 updated docs + per-row adjudication dominates; closure script is mechanical; depends on W1-W8 having landed)"

substrate_framing: |

## §W9-2. WX-W9-2 — COVERAGE-CONSISTENCY: framing invariants (IS-not-IN + fold-not-singularity + canonical-tau + substrate-derives-LCDM) + cross-document coverage of multi-doc S93-era developments

```yaml
# ---- Identity (4 fields) ----
gate_id: "WX-W9-2-COVERAGE-CONSISTENCY"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[AUDIT]"
classification: "GEOMETRIC"          # cross-document structural consistency check: the substrate-IS framing direction (phononic-framing.md) + the cross-document COMPLETENESS of multi-doc S93-era developments across the 8 docs
agent_type: "gen-physicist"
hypothesis: "All 8 W1-W8-updated documents are mutually consistent on the four framing invariants — (i) the IS-not-IN direction of explanation (D_K eigenvalues -> spectral moments -> emergent physics; never substrate-explained-via-GR-container); (ii) the fold is a first-order phase-transition transit at tau_fold=0.190, NOT a Big-Bang singularity; (iii) the canonical tau story (tau_fold=0.190 transit fold, distinct from the stabilization/epoch tau values); (iv) substrate DERIVES LCDM/GR (gravity = a_2 Seeley-DeWitt moment), never substrate-IN-a-LCDM-container — AND there is NO cross-document coverage gap: each major S93-era development pertinent to MULTIPLE documents (DILUTION-CC; the §VII cross-pillar bridge program; spectral-dimension d_s flow vs CDT; the two-scale alpha_s) is either integrated into, or explicitly cross-referenced from, every document whose domain it touches — so the eight documents are mutually non-contradicting on framing AND collectively comprehensive (no development landed in one doc while silently missed by another that owns an overlapping domain)."

method:
  description: >
    Cross-document COVERAGE + framing-consistency SWEEP (NOT a progressive derivation; context §3).
    The executor builds a single matrix: rows = the 8 updated documents; columns = the four framing
    invariants (I1-I4) PLUS a cross-document COVERAGE axis (C1-C4, one column per multi-doc
    development). Each framing cell = COMPLIANT or VIOLATION+location (document section + the specific
    container-thinking sentence). Each coverage cell = one of {PRESENT (the development is integrated
    in this doc), CROSS-REF (the doc explicitly defers to the owning doc), N/A-OUT-OF-DOMAIN (the
    development legitimately does not touch this doc's domain), or GAP (the doc owns an overlapping
    domain but neither integrates the development nor cross-references it)}.

    Framing invariants (sourced verbatim from phononic-framing.md):
      (I1) IS-not-IN direction — every explanation flows substrate -> emergent (D_K eigenvalues ->
           spectral moments -> emergent field equations -> observed physics); the §"IS Space, Not IN
           Space" error patterns (fields ON K, particles created IN curved spacetime, area-theorem-
           implies, Einstein's-equations-govern, summing-over-geometries) are VIOLATIONS.
      (I2) fold-not-singularity — the fold is a first-order phase transition / acoustic white hole at
           tau_fold=0.190, NOT a Big-Bang singularity (phononic-framing.md Exflation-vs-Inflation table).
      (I3) canonical tau story — tau_fold=0.190 is the transit fold; the stabilization (tau_0~0.15),
           earlier-estimate (0.2015), and Penrose-epoch (~0.22) values are distinct and not presented
           AS the transit fold (the Level-1 single-tau-slice vs the moduli/epoch story per
           phononic-framing.md §"Single-tau-slice vs moduli-deformation substrate-IS levels").
      (I4) substrate-derives-LCDM — gravity is the a_2 Seeley-DeWitt moment, Newton's constant is the
           second spectral moment, LCDM/GR are CONSEQUENCES; a document that frames the substrate as
           living IN a pre-existing FRW/LCDM container (rather than DERIVING it) is a VIOLATION.

    Cross-document coverage axis (the W9-specific check beyond per-doc compliance; the four
    developments are enumerated in coverage_development_set below with their owning + overlapping
    documents): for each development, verify it is PRESENT-or-CROSS-REF in EVERY document whose domain
    it touches. A development integrated in its owning doc but silently absent from a second doc that
    covers an overlapping domain is a cross-document coverage GAP (the dual of a shared-constant
    DISAGREE). The sibling-wave footers route their scoped-out gap rows + multi-doc developments here:
    W2 ("a scoped-out item missing from BOTH W2 and its target = a cross-document coverage hole"),
    W6 ("flag it for W9 so the cross-document coverage sweep confirms the scoped-out content"),
    W7 (n_s / CC-DILUTION / 3He-B-bridge / BCS overlaps), W8 (MIGRATE-FORWARD archive rows).

    The executor reads each wave's WX-W{i}-3 RECONCILE+VERIFY verdict (each wave self-audited its own
    framing + provenance) and CROSS-CHECKS: (a) the eight documents do not contradict each other's
    framing direction (e.g. W3 must not present the CC as a LCDM-container problem while W4 derives it
    substrate-first), and (b) no multi-doc development has a coverage GAP. The closure script loads the
    8 documents (SHA-pinned post-update) + the coverage+framing matrix (WP §W9-2), recomputes the
    all-compliant-and-no-gap boolean, computes the dual SHA, append_verdicts. Read-only over the 8 docs
    (W9 does not edit them; a GAP it finds routes back to the owning wave as a W{i}-side hot-fix, NOT a
    W9 edit). It does NOT re-mine the KB to re-derive the developments — the four developments + their
    owning/overlapping docs are enumerated at plan-freeze (coverage_development_set), and the per-cell
    check is a presence/cross-ref scan over the pinned post-update document text.
  producing_script: "computations/session-x/sx_w9_coverage_consistency.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "set"
  form: >
    defect_set = framing_violation_set UNION coverage_gap_set, where
      framing_violation_set = { (doc_i, invariant Ik) : doc_i post-update contains a framing violation
        of Ik (container-thinking sentence located by section + quote), OR doc_i's framing direction on
        Ik contradicts another document's direction }; and

        owning doc (CROSS-REF) — i.e. the coverage cell is GAP, not PRESENT/CROSS-REF/N/A-OUT-OF-DOMAIN }.

    non-contradicting AND every multi-doc development is covered-or-cross-referenced by every doc whose
    domain it touches). N/A-OUT-OF-DOMAIN coverage cells are EXCLUDED from coverage_gap_set by

  tolerance: "binary per cell. FRAMING cell: a document section containing a container-thinking sentence (substrate-explained-via-GR, fields-ON-K, particles-IN-curved-spacetime, area-theorem-implies, Einstein-equations-govern, summing-over-geometries, fold-as-singularity, substrate-IN-LCDM-container, or a bare non-canonical tau presented AS the transit fold) -> VIOLATION; zero tolerance for container-thinking inversion (phononic-framing.md is the standard); a cross-document framing-direction contradiction (two docs disagree on the direction of explanation for the same observable) -> VIOLATION. COVERAGE cell: a development whose domain overlaps the doc but which is neither PRESENT (integrated) nor CROSS-REF (explicitly defers to the owning doc) -> GAP; a development legitimately outside the doc's domain -> N/A-OUT-OF-DOMAIN (not a gap)"
  scheme: "CROSS-DOCUMENT-COVERAGE-CONSISTENCY-MATRIX (rows = 8 updated docs; columns = 4 framing invariants {COMPLIANT|VIOLATION+location} + 4 multi-doc developments {PRESENT|CROSS-REF|N/A-OUT-OF-DOMAIN|GAP})"

  # Same discriminator logic as WX-W9-1: the 8 post-update document SHAs pin the audited states; the
  # coverage+framing matrix is the work product (content_sha256). canonical_constants pins the I3
  # tau_fold=0.190 anchor + the C1 DILUTION-CC CC_OOM=115.5 anchor. W9 authors no document edit
  # (read-only over the 8 docs; a coverage GAP routes back to the owning wave as a W{i}-side hot-fix).

# (7) substitution_chain — required: the I3 canonical-tau direction
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    The coverage+framing matrix carries one directional claim that requires an explicit chain (per
    math-scripts.md §"Double-Check Logic Before Compute"): the I3 canonical-tau direction — that
    tau_fold=0.190 is THE transit fold and the other tau values are distinct epochs, so a document
    presenting them otherwise is the WRONG direction (the tau-quartet framing collapse). This is the
    framing-side complement of WX-W9-1 row D1 (the value-side distinct-split). The same substrate-IS
    direction grounds the coverage axis (C1-C4): a development is correctly COVERED only when rendered
    in the substrate-first direction (e.g. C1 DILUTION-CC framed as the Volovik tracking-vacuum
    resolution the substrate DERIVES, not as a LCDM-container vacuum-energy patch — the coverage check
    and the I4 framing check are the same direction applied to a development's presence vs its framing).

    Claim: "the canonical transit fold is tau_fold=0.190; presenting a bare 0.2015 / 0.22 / 0.15 as
            'the fold' inverts the canonical tau story (a framing violation), because those are
            distinct stabilization/estimate/epoch quantities, not the transit fold."

    Substitution chain:
      Step 1: tau_fold = 0.190  [get_constant("tau_fold"): S12/S42, gate CONST-FREEZE-42, Superseded=False
              — the canonical transit-fold parameter of the Jensen deformation]
      Step 2: tau_0 ~ 0.15      [the golden-ratio resonance-stabilization ATTEMPT, W1 §; dE/dtau=0 cavity
              self-tuning — a DISTINCT quantity, the stabilization target, not the realized transit fold]
      Step 3: tau = 0.2015      [an EARLIER fold ESTIMATE (W1 drift exemplar, context §2), superseded by
              the CONST-FREEZE-42 value 0.190 — a stale rendering of the SAME quantity, to be re-pinned]
      Step 4: tau ~ 0.22        [the Penrose "physical universe" EPOCH (W5), a later cosmological epoch
              on the moduli/deformation trajectory — a DISTINCT epoch, not the transit fold]
      Substitute: I3-compliant(doc) iff (doc presents tau_fold=0.190 as the transit fold) AND (doc
              does NOT present 0.15 / 0.2015 / 0.22 AS the transit fold); the 0.2015 case is a
              SUPERSEDED rendering (re-pin to 0.190), the 0.15 and 0.22 cases are DISTINCT quantities
              (keep distinct).
      Simplify: the direction is FROM the canonical substrate-IS value (0.190, Level-1 single-tau-slice)
              TOWARD the derived/epoch values; a document that elevates an epoch value (0.22) or a stale
              estimate (0.2015) to "the fold" inverts this direction (Level-2 moduli/epoch presented as
              Level-1 slice — a phononic-framing.md §"Single-tau-slice vs moduli-deformation" violation).
      Direction: tau_fold=0.190 is primary (substrate-IS, canonical, CONST-FREEZE-42); 0.15/0.2015/0.22
              are derived/stale/epoch — so the ONLY I3-compliant framing presents 0.190 as the fold and
              the others as their distinct roles.
      Conclusion: I3 column is COMPLIANT for a document iff it renders tau_fold=0.190 as the transit fold
              and scopes 0.15/0.2015/0.22 to their distinct roles; a bare non-canonical tau as "the fold"
              is an I3 VIOLATION (located by section + quote in the matrix cell). This is exactly the
              disambiguation the W1/W5/W6 UPDATE gates performed; W9 verifies it held across all 8 docs.

      - "\\*\\*Verdict\\*\\*:.*(PASS|FAIL|INFO)"
      - "\\*\\*Output Artifacts\\*\\*"
      - "\\*\\*MCP Pre-Compute Audit\\*\\*"
      - "coverage"                       # the rows=8-docs x columns=(4-invariants + 4-developments) coverage+framing table

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  The defect set is EMPTY: all 8 updated documents are COMPLIANT on all four framing invariants
  (I1 IS-not-IN direction, I2 fold-not-singularity, I3 canonical-tau, I4 substrate-derives-LCDM) AND
  do not contradict each other's framing direction, AND every multi-doc S93-era development (C1
  DILUTION-CC, C2 §VII cross-pillar bridge program, C3 spectral-dimension d_s flow vs CDT, C4 two-scale
  alpha_s) is PRESENT or CROSS-REF in every document whose domain it overlaps (no coverage GAP). This
  certifies the eight W1-W8 UPDATE+VERIFY gates produced a corpus that is BOTH framing-coherent (a
  single substrate-IS direction of explanation across all 8 docs) AND collectively comprehensive (no
  multi-doc development landed in one document while silently missed by another that owns an overlapping
  domain). PASS = the family reads as one coherent, complete substrate-first corpus, not eight
  independently-framed documents with coverage holes between them.
FAIL_meaning: >
  At least one defect survives: (framing) a document carries a framing violation post-update (a
  container-thinking sentence located by section + quote: substrate-explained-via-GR, fold-as-singularity,
  a bare non-canonical tau as "the fold", or substrate-IN-a-LCDM-container) OR two documents contradict
  each other's framing direction for the same observable (e.g. one derives the CC substrate-first while
  another frames it as a LCDM-container vacuum problem); OR (coverage) a multi-doc development is PRESENT
  in its owning document but has a GAP in a document whose domain overlaps it (e.g. DILUTION-CC integrated
  in W3 cosmos but silently absent from W6's §V.4 closure record that the W6 footer says should carry it;
  or the §VII bridge program in W1/W2 but missing from W7's 3He-B-inheritance section). The named
  document + invariant/development + location is the blocker; the fix is a W{i}-side surgical re-edit
  (a WX-W{i}-2/3-class correction) then re-verify, surfaced by W9 (not performed by W9). The session-x
  cross-document coverage+framing certificate is withheld until the defect is closed.
INFO_meaning: >
  All 8 docs are individually framing-compliant and no coverage GAP exists, but >=1 boundary case needs
  a one-line annotation: either (framing) a document legitimately quotes LCDM/inflation vocabulary in a
  clearly-labeled comparison/translation passage that describes the comparison container, NOT the
  substrate's own description (admissible per phononic-framing.md's NON-PHONONIC classification), or
  (coverage) a development is CROSS-REF rather than PRESENT in an overlapping doc (covered at the
  document-set level via an explicit pointer to the owning doc — a legitimate scoping decision the W2/W6
  footers anticipate), worth flagging so a future reader sees the coverage is distributed-by-reference,
  not missing. INFO records the labeled-comparison + cross-ref-coverage annotations; the corpus remains
  framing-compliant and collectively comprehensive.

# ---- Effort + framing ----
effort:
  files_created:
    - "computations/session-x/sx_w9_coverage_consistency.py"
    - "computations/session-x/sx_w9_coverage_consistency.npz"   # optional
    - "sessions/session-x/session-x-w9-workingpaper.md (§W9-2 section + coverage+framing matrix)"
  estimated_time: "0.5 wave-equivalents (reading each of the 8 updated docs for the four framing invariants + the four-development coverage check + the cross-document direction/coverage adjudication dominates; closure script is mechanical; depends on W1-W8 having landed)"

substrate_framing: |
  GEOMETRIC. The four framing invariants ARE the substrate-IS direction of explanation made into a
  cross-document audit, and the four-development coverage axis is the substrate-first COMPLETENESS
  audit at the corpus scale. I1 (IS-not-IN) is the core phononic-framing.md mandate: every explanation
  flows D_K eigenvalues -> spectral moments -> emergent field equations -> observed physics; the
  substrate is logically prior and GR/QFT/thermodynamics are consequences. I2 (fold-not-singularity)
  preserves the exflation-not-inflation reframe: the fold is a first-order phase transition / acoustic
  white hole at tau_fold=0.190, not a metric singularity. I3 (canonical-tau) preserves the Level-1
  single-tau-slice vs Level-2 moduli/epoch distinction (tau_fold=0.190 is the substrate-IS transit fold;
  the other tau values are distinct epochs/attempts on the deformation trajectory). I4
  (substrate-derives-LCDM) preserves the moment-hierarchy: gravity = a_2 Seeley-DeWitt, Newton's
  constant = second spectral moment, LCDM/GR are emergent. The coverage axis (C1-C4) checks that the
  major S93-era substrate developments — the DILUTION-CC tracking-vacuum resolution (a_0 moment), the
  §VII cross-pillar bridges (substrate-IS <-> laboratory-IN), the spectral-dimension d_s flow (a
  diffusion functional of Tr e^{-sigma D_K^2}), and the two-scale alpha_s (substrate-distance Mellin
  residue vs Goldstone-pivot running) — appear coherently wherever the substrate's own structure

```

## Wave 9 → close Decision Point

**Wave 9 is the LAST wave of session-x; its verdicts CLOSE the session.** There is no Wave 10. W9 has no downstream wave that consumes it; its two verdicts are the session-x cross-document consistency + coverage certificate. The session-close branching:

- **`WX-W9-1` PASS + `WX-W9-2` PASS** → session-x closes CLEAN: the eight phononic documents are reconciled to the current S93-era aggregate (W1–W8), mutually agree on every shared constant (with all distinct-quantity splits correctly separated), read as one coherent substrate-first corpus on all four framing invariants, AND collectively cover every multi-doc S93-era development (DILUTION-CC, the §VII bridge program, spectral-dimension d_s/CDT, the two-scale α_s) with no cross-document coverage gap. The session handoff records the two W9 PASS lines as the closeout certificate; no cross-document carry-forward.
- **`WX-W9-1` INFO and/or `WX-W9-2` INFO** (distinct-quantity splits / labeled-comparison annotations / cross-ref-distributed coverage, no residual SAME-quantity disagreement, no framing violation, no coverage GAP) → session-x closes with the documented distinct-quantity + distributed-coverage structure: the tau quartet, the e-fold channels, the n_s pair, the sin²θ_W pair, the Mach pair, the EoS quartet are recorded as annotated distinct rows, and any CROSS-REF-distributed development is noted as covered-by-pointer; the session is consistent + comprehensive, with the distinct-quantity + coverage map as a permanent reference. INFO is a clean closeout, not a defect (per `gate-verdicts.md` — INFO fired a pre-registered clause). Any genuinely UNVERIFIABLE item the matrix surfaces propagates to the next compute session's plan per `feedback_fix-in-session-never-defer.md` (4-field spec), NOT as a workshop.
- **`WX-W9-1` FAIL and/or `WX-W9-2` FAIL** (a residual SAME-quantity cross-document disagreement, a collapsed distinct quantity, a framing violation/contradiction, OR a cross-document coverage GAP — a multi-doc development present in its owning doc but silently absent from an overlapping doc) → session-x closes with the named cross-document defect as the leading carry-forward. The remediation is a W{i}-side re-run of the relevant `WX-W{i}-2`/`WX-W{i}-3` after correction (W9 SURFACES the blocker; W9 never edits the eight documents — it is a read-only verification sweep). Per the partition manifest, **W9 is droppable at the Phase-3b checkpoint** without affecting W1–W8: a W9 FAIL does NOT invalidate the standalone updated documents (each stands alone per its own three landed verdicts); it only withholds the cross-document agreement/framing/coverage certificate. If a W9 gate honestly closes PRE-REG-INC because a prerequisite `WX-W{i}-2` did not land (see Decision Point Prerequisites), the unmet prerequisite is the leading carry-forward and W9 re-runs once W{i} lands.

**Verification-sweep scope reminder** (context §3): W9 does NOT change W1–W8's aggregate-sourcing discipline and does NOT re-derive any constant or re-mine the aggregate state. It checks post-update mutual consistency (the matrices) and confirms agreement with the canonical reference. The analytic work was W1–W8's; W9's work is the cross-document agreement adjudication + the dual-SHA closure.

## Wave 9 Machinery-Enumeration Pin

Aggregate of both gate `machinery_pin_map` entries (per `.claude/rules/epistemic-discipline.md §"Pre-Registration Completeness"` PRDR; read by `computations/_shared/_yaml_gate_validator.py` for sig_4 of the v3 closure ladder). Both W9 gates are **cross-document consistency gates** (context §4 prose-reconciliation-gate adaptation): no numerical scan, no GPU linear algebra, deterministic.

| Gate | N_eval | L_max | scan_range | step_size | tolerance | scheme | convention | random_seed | GPU_path |
|:-----|:-------|:------|:-----------|:----------|:----------|:-------|:-----------|:------------|:---------|
| WX-W9-1 SHARED-CONSTANT-MATRIX | N/A (grid = shared-constant-rows × doc-pairs, fixed) | N/A | N/A | N/A | rel_tol 1e-3 (presentation precision) on SAME-quantity rows; exact for integer constants (N_cells); distinct-quantity diff → INFO-row not FAIL | CROSS-DOCUMENT-AGREEMENT-MATRIX | SET-AGREEMENT (empty disagreement set = PASS) | N/A — deterministic | N/A |
| WX-W9-2 COVERAGE-CONSISTENCY | N/A (grid = 8 docs × (4 framing invariants + 4 multi-doc developments) = 64 cells, fixed) | N/A | N/A | N/A | binary per cell; framing: zero tolerance for container-thinking inversion + zero for cross-document framing-direction contradiction; coverage: a multi-doc development absent (neither PRESENT nor CROSS-REF) from an overlapping doc → GAP; N/A-OUT-OF-DOMAIN excluded | CROSS-DOCUMENT-COVERAGE-CONSISTENCY-MATRIX | SET-COMPLIANCE-AND-COVERAGE (empty defect set = framing_violation_set ∪ coverage_gap_set = empty = PASS) | N/A — deterministic | N/A |

**Common machinery (both gates):**
- **KB tools**: `mcp__knowledge__{get_constant, list_constants}` (WX-W9-1 reference column: a SINGLE canonical lookup per shared-constant row) + `mcp__knowledge__{search_knowledge, trace_entity}` (WX-W9-2, OPTIONAL, only to confirm a contested framing claim's substrate-IS provenance or a contested coverage-development owning/overlapping-doc boundary). **This is NOT a re-mining of the aggregate state** — that was W1–W8's job per context §3; W9 reads the canonical reference once per row and otherwise consumes the W1–W8 outputs (the eight documents + their gap-integration ledgers). Recorded in the WP "MCP Pre-Compute Audit" block (mandatory per `workingpaper.md` Rule 3).
- **Canonical snapshot**: `computations/_shared/canonical_constants.py` (SHA pinned at dispatch in the Input-SHA Ledger below) — the reference column for WX-W9-1 and the I3 `tau_fold=0.190` + C1 `CC_OOM=115.5` anchors for WX-W9-2.
- **The eight document SHAs**: `<computed-at-runtime>` for all eight, each = the **post-`WX-W{i}-2`** updated state (and post-`WX-W{i}-3` for the coverage+framing gate). W9 is read-only over the eight documents; the SHAs pin EXACTLY which document states the matrices were built over, so the audit trail proves W9 ran on the post-update corpus.
- **Verdict taxonomy**: per-row `{AGREE, DISTINCT-SPLIT, DISAGREE}` (WX-W9-1) and per-cell `{COMPLIANT, VIOLATION}` (framing columns) + `{PRESENT, CROSS-REF, N/A-OUT-OF-DOMAIN, GAP}` (coverage columns) (WX-W9-2); the gate composite is PASS iff the disagreement set (W9-1) / defect set = framing_violation_set ∪ coverage_gap_set (W9-2) is empty (with distinct-split rows + N/A-OUT-OF-DOMAIN cells excluded by construction → INFO if any distinct-split row / CROSS-REF coverage cell is present and no DISAGREE/VIOLATION/GAP).
- **Closure-script pattern**: each gate's `sx_w9_*.py` loads the eight documents + the canonical snapshot + the agent-authored matrix (WP §W9-N), recomputes the per-row/per-cell agreement/compliance/coverage boolean from the pinned document SHAs, computes the dual SHA (`audit_sha256` over the input-pin map = the eight doc SHAs + matrix + canonical snapshot; `content_sha256` over the matrix artifact), and `append_verdict`s to `computations/session-x/sx_gate_verdicts.txt` per `gate-verdicts.md` (atomic single `open("a")` append via the canonical `append_verdict()` helper — NEVER a read-modify-write of the verdict file). Scripts import from `canonical_constants` (S34+ discipline) and tag any computed intermediate `# (local)`.

**PRU note**: these gates have no free numerical machinery parameters (no scan/seed/L_max). The `machinery_pin_map` enumerates the consistency-procedure pins (agreement band, scheme, verdict taxonomy, KB tools, canonical snapshot, the eight document SHAs, the shared-constant row set, the framing-invariant set, the coverage-development set) rather than compute parameters. This is the documented cross-document-consistency-gate adaptation of the R3 field mapping (context §4); the gate is PRU-clear because every gate-relevant pin (what counts as agreement vs disagreement, which constants are distinct-split rows, which developments are multi-doc with which owning/overlapping docs, what counts as a coverage GAP vs N/A-OUT-OF-DOMAIN, which canonical the reference column targets, which document states the gate reads) is fixed at plan-freeze, leaving no execution-time freedom.

## Wave 9 Input-SHA Ledger

Every input file the W9 gates consume, per `.claude/rules/gate-verdicts.md`. Static infrastructure files would get precomputed hashes at plan-freeze (cross-checked by `computations/_shared/_plan_upstream_pin_validator.py`); here ALL document inputs use `<computed-at-runtime>` because they are the **post-update** states produced by W1–W8 during the same session-x run (their final SHAs do not exist until each `WX-W{i}-2`/`WX-W{i}-3` lands). This is the intended dependency: W9 captures each document's post-update SHA at its own dispatch, AFTER the prerequisite UPDATE gates have landed (see Decision Point Prerequisites). `canonical_constants.py` and `knowledge.db` are also runtime-pinned (session-x may run W9 after concurrent constant promotions in sibling waves; `knowledge.db` is rebuilt by `/weave --update`).
